messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: AtlasOps EBR dry run tomorrow 10am PT. Need slide deck finalization + exec asks. Can folks confirm owner for slide 4 (onboarding health) and slide 7 (renewal risk)?

Carlos Vega: I can own slide 7 (renewal risk) — will add renewal forecast + churn heatmap. Need last 30d usage numbers (daily active hosts + avg tokens/session).

Leah Park: I'll take slide 4 (onboarding health). Will pull onboarding status, success measures, and the training completion rates. Where's the latest onboarding CSV? Either S3 link or GDrive.

Maya Chen: Deck: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AtlasOps-EBR-v3 — please comment inline by EOD. Agenda:
```
10:00 - 10:05 Intro (Maya)
10:05 - 10:20 Product adoption + health (Leah)
10:20 - 10:35 Renewal scenario + commercial ask (Carlos)
10:35 - 10:45 Exec asks / action review
```

Jonah Patel: Can we include last week's model latency incident as a one-slide timeline? It caused a ~12% dip in satisfaction and a couple of failed jobs.

Leah Park: Yep — I'll add a mini timeline + mitigations (rollback, kernel patch, autoscaler tweak). Will link logs from eng-oncall.

cs-bot: Reminder: Dry-run invite sent to execs and AtlasOps for tomorrow 10:00 PT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=atlasops-dryrun

Maya Chen: Consolidated action items (please ack & set status):
- Leah Park — update slide 4 with onboarding metrics + attach CSV (s3://redwood-sharing/atlasops/onboarding_2026-03.csv) — due today 17:00 PT
- Carlos Vega — add renewal forecast slides + ARR impact scenarios (+/- 2 churn levers) — due today 17:00 PT
- Jonah Patel — 2-sentence incident summary + timeline for slide (include mitigations & next steps) — due today 15:00 PT
- Maya Chen — consolidate comments, export PDF, and email execs + AtlasOps — due tomorrow 09:00 PT

Maya Chen: Exec ask framing: 1) Quick adoption wins we need help resourcing, 2) Ask for two-week pilot budget for Dedicated nodes, 3) A signed statement of continued adoption (renewal signal). Keep asks tight — 1 slide each.

Carlos Vega: Ack. I'll populate scenarios and a 1-sentence ask per scenario.

Leah Park: Ack. I'll post the CSV and a short note in this thread when done.

Jonah Patel: Ack. Will post the incident blurb here by 14:30.

Maya Chen: Thanks all :thumbsup: If anyone wants to rehearse before 9am tomorrow ping me — otherwise I'll run the dry-run at 09:30 with the team.
